text: Here are the ruins I talked about. Magical, right?
zh: 这就是我说过的遗迹。很神奇，对吧？

text: But we're not here for sightseeing.
zh: 不过我们可不是来观光的。

text: The stone in the middle tells about certain Pale Coins, but I am not sure about their existence. These texts are ancient, therefore the coins may already be lost.
zh: 中间那块石碑上记载着某种苍白硬币，但我不确定它们是否真的存在。这些文字非常古老，硬币也许早已失落。

text: But what's even more interesting is this round thing right here.
zh: 但更有意思的，是这里的这个圆形物件。

text: It emits a very potent magical aura. It caused me to fear for the safety of the camp, so I ordered the mine to be closed.
zh: 它散发着非常强大的魔法气息。我担心营地的安全，所以才下令封锁矿井。

text: However, I feel like this stone right here is the answer to your questions.
zh: 不过，我觉得眼前这块石头正是你那些疑问的答案。

text: Do you know what this is?
I don't even know what purpose it serves for this place.
zh: 我甚至不知道它对这个地方有什么用处。

text: Before we destroyed the wall to the north by accident, there was no way of entering nor leaving this place.
zh: 在我们不小心毁掉北面的墙之前，这地方根本无路可进，也无路可出。

text: Even though the energy the stone emits is strong, I feel as though it is inactive.
zh: 尽管这块石头散发的能量很强，我却感觉它处于休眠状态。

text: Based on a few of those texts, I might be able to reactivate it.
zh: 根据其中几段文字，我也许能重新激活它。

text: Don't waste any time. As soon as the stone lights up, try and grab it.
zh: 别浪费时间。石头一亮起来，就设法抓住它。

text: I don't know how long I'll be able to have it active, so we don't want to miss our chance, right?
zh: 我不知道自己能让它保持激活多久，所以我们可不能错过机会，对吧？
